parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human Orexin receptor type 2 (CHEMBL4792). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4792 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
